ipr_definition: p_a = |psi[2a]|^2 + |psi[2a+1]|^2 (sum 1); IPR = sum p_a^2; P = 1/IPR; uniform over n tiles -> 1/n

trivial_pinned.solver: dense eigh subset (n x n tile operator); H_trivial = (this) (x) I_2, each eigenvalue doubly degenerate

trivial_free.solver: dense eigh subset (n x n tile operator); H_trivial = (this) (x) I_2, each eigenvalue doubly degenerate
